assets.name: 강낭콩
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a NEW standalone character illustration for an original Korean classroom trading card game, 콩 거래 / BEAN TRADING.
Primary request: a FUNNY, memorable cranberry-red kidney-bean BARGAINING HUSTLER, caught mid-action in a visual joke. The bean itself is the full body, with an unmistakable bent kidney-bean silhouette and two spindly arms and legs. It is lunging eagerly toward the viewer and proudly presenting ONE TINY gold coin between huge gesturing fingers as if it were an irresistible deal, while its other arm desperately holds an absurdly overflowing wicker basket of bean produce tucked under its side. The basket is slipping; two large beans tumble out. The character is trying comically hard to act cool.
Expression is the star: one eyebrow raised ridiculously high, the other pressed low, narrow knowing eyes looking directly at the viewer, a huge crooked self-satisfied grin with one square tooth, one small nervous sweat drop. Face asymmetrical and full of attitude; no generic friendly smile. Body strongly curved in a sweeping S-shaped comic action line, one heel lifted, slightly off balance. A tiny teal merchant vest fits badly over its large red bean belly; short ochre scarf flies backward. The costume must leave most of the red bean body visible. No hat.
Art direction: lively 2D editorial cartoon and premium comic board-game art; confidently varied dark-ink line weight, exaggerated squash-and-stretch anatomy, boldly simplified shapes, restrained gouache and screenprint grain within flat rich colors, warm cream highlights. HAND-DRAWN, GRAPHIC, WITTY. Red, teal and ochre are the main colors. Action and face must remain obvious at thumbnail size. NOT 3D, not a shiny realistic bean, not a generic preschool mascot, not stock clipart, not symmetrical, not a static idle pose. Original design, do not imitate any existing commercial bean-game characters.
Composition: one single full-body character plus its basket, tiny coin and two falling beans as one compact readable vignette, all parts fully inside a square canvas with ample clean margins. Genuine transparent background; no ground plane, no card frame, no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no logo, no watermark, no colored backdrop.

assets.name: 대두
assets.subject: A VERY ROUND golden-yellow soybean who hoards coins. Its almost spherical bean belly has a short brown hilum, so silhouette is much wider and rounder than the reference. A comically undersized burgundy waistcoat strains around its belly. The bean is sitting back on its heels, hugging a bulging drawstring purse bigger than its own head; three gold coins are escaping through a hole at the bottom while it smugly watches the top opening, completely unaware of the leak. Eyes squinted in possessive delight, one rounded cheek puffed out, a satisfied little mouth with one tooth, bushy eyebrows. One foot is accidentally standing on a fallen coin and tilted. Funny lovable greed, no villain styling. Gold body, burgundy cloth, dark brown purse. Keep the whole simple comic action legible.

assets.name: 녹두
assets.subject: A small BRIGHT GREEN MUNG BEAN courier with a compact straight-sided oval-capsule body, not a kidney shape, and a small pale hilum mark. It sprints with a huge exaggerated forward lean, legs at a cartoon impossible angle, struggling under THREE wooden produce crates stacked at a dangerously wobbling angle. The top crate lid is popping open and one green bean bounces upward. Wide terrified white eyes glance up toward the wobbling stack while the mouth remains stubbornly determined. Wears an orange-red visor cap backwards and a tiny simple cross-body courier pouch; no words. One ridiculously long shoelace trails behind a shoe. Green bean, warm orange accents, ochre wooden boxes. Composition is dynamic and compact, entire stack and feet visible.

assets.name: 흰콩
assets.subject: A TALL THIN ivory-white cannellini bean novice gardener, with long gently curved body, cream shadows and a narrow pale hilum. It has proudly lifted a bright blue watering can too high; the spout points BACK toward its own head and the water lands on it instead of the tiny seedling in a terracotta pot by its foot. It stares sideways in startled disbelief at the stream with very wide unequal eyes, open little zigzag mouth and raised brows; a stray sprout leaf is plastered across its forehead. Wearing a very small green gardening apron and oversized work boots. One knee lifted instinctively out of the way. Light ivory body cleanly readable against transparency, blue watering can, one small orange pot. A funny gentle accident. Keep visual gag as a compact full-body silhouette with just a short water stream.
